sensitivity_definitions.definition: Evidence-withholding stress test. Frozen derived positives become unknown in this scenario only; original unknowns remain unknown. This does not establish that direct evidence is absent.
Omit all-cause mortality derivation modality. AE derivations remain admissible. This is not a direct-only scenario.
Composition sensitivity excluding the four ratified amendment populations. Not a claim of ineligibility; the authorized main core remains28.
Descriptive programme stratum; no randomized comparison between programmes.
Composition sensitivity removing SCALE; no inference of a drug or programme effect.
Descriptive programme stratum; no randomized comparison between programmes.
Composition sensitivity removing STEP; no inference of a drug or programme effect.
Descriptive programme stratum; no randomized comparison between programmes.
Composition sensitivity removing SURMOUNT; no inference of a drug or programme effect.

Different estimand: each registry is complete only if every member randomized population is complete. Secondary: AND across population-specific ORs, not OR of registry-level ANDs. No patient counts are pooled.
